reason: Use existing MIRIX raw source/vector storage and an atomic Blaine metadata-only registry in the same approved PostgreSQL database. Public raw writes select mutable agent configuration and age-only cleanup does not own Blaine retention. No different memory database/service or upstream MIRIX edit.

exact_source_preservation.implemented: Exact UTF-8 source, digest, scoped facade readback before receipt; source/vector/registry transaction.
exact_source_preservation.evidence: HERMETIC protocol tests pass; native write/readback not run.

blaine_metadata_preservation.implemented: Versioned metadata stores context, domain, origin, status, retention, creator, source Task and digest. Scoped retry identity is registry-owned; no caller IDs.
blaine_metadata_preservation.evidence: Closed schema/provenance/forgery tests pass; native schema and metadata transaction pending.

automatic_derived_processing.implemented: One explicitly granted local embedding per new source, no embedding on replay. No public ingestion/extraction/auto-dream path or vector retrieval.
automatic_derived_processing.evidence: Endpoint/model/proxy/redirect restrictions in adapter; native vector creation pending.

derived_scope_inheritance.implemented: Vector resides on the same MIRIX raw row, organization/user and opaque context/domain partition as source. Registry joins authorize before content loading/limit.
derived_scope_inheritance.evidence: Facade defense-in-depth and isolation tests pass; native SQL scope proof pending. No blanket claim for other MIRIX APIs/caches.

blaine_retention_ownership.implemented: Only AGENT_OBSERVATION/UNVERIFIED/WORKING and explicitly authorized USER_DECLARATION/DECLARED/RETAINED tuples. No upgrade API. FK restricts ungoverned raw deletion.
blaine_retention_ownership.evidence: Status/forgery/reconstruction tests pass; native restrictive-FK and restart checks pending. No TTL or automatic retention policy inferred.

governed_retrieval_separation.implemented: Current-context/source-Task WORKING, permitted ancestral RETAINED, then SecurityContext/policy intersection; lexical/exact facade feeds existing Resolver/Compiler.
governed_retrieval_separation.evidence: Fresh delta and actual Cognitive Loop worker delivery/replay tests pass; native compiled composition pending. Preference precedence explicitly deferred by roadmap.

no_implicit_upward_flow.implemented: Write grant must match current context. Parent declarations require direct operator binding. No child copying or parent visibility; retained inheritance only down permitted lineage.
no_implicit_upward_flow.evidence: Deterministic parent/sibling/context forgery and retained inheritance tests pass; native post-restart isolation pending.

authorized_processing_and_egress.implemented: Private per-binding domain grant explicitly allows local processing. Fixed existing port 8001 embedding route; redirects/proxies/alternate provider and DSN host overrides refused.
authorized_processing_and_egress.evidence: Deterministic configuration/admission tests pass; real local embedding call pending.

native_attempt.detail: SQLAlchemy driver URL was not normalized for libpq. Fixed in e84e08d; read-only DB/identity check PASS. Corrected probe must be independently republished before rerun.

limits: Native schema installation, persistence, local embedding creation, facade readback and restart are not yet qualified.
Foreign-key retention guard may cause an age-cleanup transaction touching admitted rows to fail; no assertion that all legacy cleanup continues unaffected.
No implicit status transition or deletion schedule; broader governed retention/removal lifecycle remains deferred.
No machine-level recovery, distributed authentication, backend-wide permission proof, deployment rollout or source migration claim.
next_increment: Finish CP.2 canonical HOST acceptance; no CP.3.
